name: Claude Auto Review
description: Automated code review using Claude AI with configurable project context

anthropic_api_key.description: Anthropic API key for Claude access

model.description: Claude model to use for reviews

timeout_minutes.description: DEPRECATED: Accepted but ignored by v1 (no effect). Use job-level timeout-minutes instead.

custom_prompt.description: Complete custom prompt override. If provided, all other prompt-related inputs are ignored.

project_context.description: Additional project-specific context to help Claude understand your codebase

comment_pr_findings.description: Post inline PR comments generated from findings.json

force_breaking_changes_agent.description: Force breaking changes agent regardless of heuristic

force_license_compliance_agent.description: Force license compliance agent regardless of heuristic

force_data_classification_agent.description: Force data classification agent regardless of heuristic

allowed_bots.description: Comma-separated bot actors allowed to trigger the review, or '*' for all bots
